runtime_mode: baseline disables all proactive creation requests; retains primary hiring preparation
build_command: PYTHONPATH=. scons release=1 CXXFLAGS=-g0 client_profile=full server=0 -j4
runs: 32 seeds 42..73 per map, 32768-tick cap, 4 participants, two concurrent matches; no timing comparison
oracle: Private full gradient from current live map state at pending query; no writes to live fields or RNG. Cache invalidated by tracked map generations, identity and slot epoch; per-tick cache bounded. A cell whose origin is blocked is assessed via the best legal reachable neighbor, with its own counts reported.
comparisons: Direct wrapped 8-way heading to building centre (flag position for flags), with ground collision checks; flyer-style ordered alternatives +1,-1,+2,-2,+3,-3,+4 when preferred step blocked. All tied best-scoring gradient steps count as correct.
limitations: Accuracy counterfactual only; heuristic does not move units.
Fresh static-world route oracle is not a prediction of map changes before queued publication.
Ground occupancy at each query affects legality; other units may move later.
No frame-time, CPU, arrival-time, starvation, match-outcome or cross-device claim.
Service-selection rows assess directions to candidates, not which building a distance heuristic would select.
